event_name: October 21-22, 2024 record cloudburst (India Meteorological Department GKVK 186.2 mm)

observed_rainfall.note: IMD GKVK station recorded 186.2 mm, the highest single-day October rainfall for Bengaluru in 27 years (previous record 178.9 mm on Oct 1, 1997). BBMP reported 157 mm over six hours in the Yelahanka zone; the city received 264.5 mm up to 8:30 am on Oct 22. Revenue Minister Krishna Byre Gowda described a 'cloud-burst-like' situation. Two lakes (Kogilu, Doddabommasandra) breached; NDRF/SDRF boats were deployed at Kendriya Vihar; ~100 lakes were reported overflowing.
